name: branding-red-lit-woman-laptop-with-floating-finance-cards
title: Red-Lit Portrait with Floating Finance Cards
whatItIs: A photo of a smiling woman at a laptop lit in deep red at night, overlaid with a red card and a white card showing profit numbers, and white and orange line graphs weaving through the frame, with a caption 'A smooth experience that builds confidence and trust from day one'.
whatItMeans: Red lighting keeps the photography on-brand, and floating numbers connect a human moment to product value.
techniques: Photo graded entirely in the brand red
UI stat cards overlaid on the person
Line graph running through the whole frame
Caption with alternating bright and dim words
Rounded frame edge matching other slides

vocabulary.definition: Colour grading photography to the brand palette.
Chart lines drawn over a photo as graphic texture.
A card with a number placed on an image.
